report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with sub-350ms durations; traces show healthy downstream calls and no errors. Metrics show /v1/checkout p95 of 425ms but no 5xx and no dependency-operation series. Current evidence does not establish any bounded root cause; the elevated p95 alone is insufficient to attribute a cause, so hand off for deeper dependency and baseline data.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency/error breakdown for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql to localize the 425ms p95 checkout latency
Baseline p95 latency for /v1/checkout to confirm whether 425ms is anomalous
Postgres connection pool saturation metrics (active/waiting) to assess db-pool-exhaustion
Redis operation latency/timeout metrics to assess redis-timeout
Deployment/version history to correlate latency onset with any change
